description: This file defines React components and context providers for a Next.js web application, including internationalization, theming, feature flags, and integrations with external services. It is specific to the web app's provider setup and routing logic.

methods.name: getEmbedNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves the embed namespace from URL query or window object for theming purposes.

methods.name: CustomI18nextProvider
methods.description: Provides internationalization context, manages document language and direction based on user session locale.

methods.name: getThemeProviderProps
methods.description: Generates theme provider configuration including storage key, forced theme, and support options based on context and embed mode.
